set_budget.title: Set overall budget
set_budget.tip: Decide how much you can spend before you lock in any vendors.

draft_guest_list.title: Draft guest list
draft_guest_list.tip: Build a rough headcount early so venue and catering quotes stay realistic.

choose_wedding_date.title: Choose wedding date
choose_wedding_date.tip: Pick a date that works for your families and your must-have venue.

book_ceremony_venue.title: Book ceremony venue
book_ceremony_venue.tip: Reserve the place where you will say your vows.

book_reception_venue.title: Book reception venue
book_reception_venue.tip: Secure the space for dinner and dancing, if separate from the ceremony.

hire_planner.title: Hire wedding planner
hire_planner.tip: A planner can save you time and reduce stress if budget allows.

book_photographer.title: Book photographer
book_photographer.tip: Book early because top photographers fill up fast.

book_videographer.title: Book videographer
book_videographer.tip: Capture the day in motion so you can relive it.

book_caterer.title: Book caterer
book_caterer.tip: Taste samples and confirm they can handle your guest count.

start_wedding_website.title: Start wedding website
start_wedding_website.tip: Build a simple site with your story, travel details, and registry links.

research_marriage_license.title: Research marriage license requirements
research_marriage_license.tip: Check county rules now so there are no surprises when it is time to apply.

book_florist.title: Book florist
book_florist.tip: Share inspiration photos and agree on a floral budget.

book_dj_band.title: Book DJ or band
book_dj_band.tip: Listen to samples or attend a live show before you commit.

send_save_the_dates.title: Send save-the-dates
send_save_the_dates.tip: Let guests know the date early so they can plan travel.

buy_wedding_dress.title: Buy wedding dress
buy_wedding_dress.tip: Order early because custom gowns can take months to arrive.

book_officiant.title: Book officiant
book_officiant.tip: Find someone who will personalize the ceremony for you.

choose_wedding_party.title: Choose wedding party
choose_wedding_party.tip: Ask your closest friends and family to stand with you.

book_hotel_block.title: Book hotel room block
book_hotel_block.tip: Reserve a group of rooms for out-of-town guests.

plan_honeymoon.title: Plan honeymoon
plan_honeymoon.tip: Decide where to go and start booking flights and hotels.

create_gift_registry.title: Create gift registry
create_gift_registry.tip: Register for gifts you will actually use and love.

order_wedding_rings.title: Order wedding rings
order_wedding_rings.tip: Have them sized and ordered well before the big day.

schedule_engagement_photos.title: Schedule engagement photos
schedule_engagement_photos.tip: Use them for your website, invitations, and save-the-dates.

book_hair_makeup.title: Book hair and makeup artists
book_hair_makeup.tip: Trial runs help you find the perfect look for the day.

book_ceremony_musicians.title: Book ceremony musicians
book_ceremony_musicians.tip: Live music adds a special touch to the ceremony.

order_invitations.title: Order wedding invitations
order_invitations.tip: Order them early so you have time to address and mail them.

finalize_menu.title: Finalize menu with caterer
finalize_menu.tip: Confirm selections, dietary restrictions, and service style.

schedule_cake_tasting.title: Schedule cake tasting
schedule_cake_tasting.tip: Try a few flavors and designs before you order.

book_rehearsal_dinner.title: Book rehearsal dinner venue
book_rehearsal_dinner.tip: Reserve a spot for the night before the wedding.

plan_ceremony_details.title: Plan ceremony details
plan_ceremony_details.tip: Decide readings, music, and who will do what during the ceremony.

order_wedding_cake.title: Order wedding cake
order_wedding_cake.tip: Place the order once you have a final guest count estimate.

buy_wedding_party_gifts.title: Buy wedding party gifts
buy_wedding_party_gifts.tip: Thank your bridesmaids and groomsmen with thoughtful gifts.

schedule_dress_fittings.title: Schedule dress fittings
schedule_dress_fittings.tip: Book fittings so the dress fits perfectly by the big day.

plan_day_of_timeline.title: Plan day-of timeline
plan_day_of_timeline.tip: Outline the schedule from getting ready to last dance.

write_wedding_vows.title: Write wedding vows
write_wedding_vows.tip: Start early so you can refine them and practice aloud.

apply_marriage_license.title: Apply for marriage license
apply_marriage_license.tip: Do this within the required window before the wedding.

mail_invitations.title: Mail wedding invitations
mail_invitations.tip: Send them 6-8 weeks before the wedding.

final_dress_fitting.title: Final dress fitting
final_dress_fitting.tip: Make sure the dress is perfect and ready for pickup.

confirm_final_headcount.title: Confirm final headcount
confirm_final_headcount.tip: Give your caterer and venue the exact number of guests.

create_seating_chart.title: Create seating chart
create_seating_chart.tip: Arrange guests at tables to encourage great conversation.

pay_final_vendor_balances.title: Pay final vendor balances
pay_final_vendor_balances.tip: Settle all remaining payments before the wedding day.

pack_emergency_kit.title: Pack wedding day emergency kit
pack_emergency_kit.tip: Include safety pins, tissues, mints, and a sewing kit.

pick_up_dress.title: Pick up wedding dress
pick_up_dress.tip: Bring it home and keep it in a safe, clean place.

set_up_everly_guest_camera.title: Set up the Everly guest camera
set_up_everly_guest_camera.tip: Guests scan a QR and every photo lands in one album.

relax_and_get_excited.title: Relax and get excited
relax_and_get_excited.tip: You have done the work — now enjoy the final days of being engaged.

final_vendor_confirmations.title: Final vendor confirmations
final_vendor_confirmations.tip: Call or email each vendor to confirm arrival times and final details.

write_toasts_schedule.title: Write toasts schedule
write_toasts_schedule.tip: Decide who is speaking and when so the reception flows smoothly.

break_in_shoes.title: Break in wedding shoes
break_in_shoes.tip: Wear them around the house for a few hours to avoid day-of blisters.

share_guest_camera_qr.title: Share guest camera QR
share_guest_camera_qr.tip: Include the QR on signs, programs, or a welcome note so guests know where to share.

deliver_seating_to_venue.title: Deliver seating chart to venue
deliver_seating_to_venue.tip: Send the final seating and table assignments before the venue prints them.

pack_for_honeymoon.title: Pack for honeymoon
pack_for_honeymoon.tip: Pack passports, chargers, and outfits so you can leave without stress.

prepare_vendor_tips.title: Prepare vendor tips
prepare_vendor_tips.tip: Organize cash or thank-you envelopes for each vendor you want to tip.

get_manicure.title: Get manicure
get_manicure.tip: Book a relaxing manicure a day or two before the wedding.

eat_breakfast.title: Eat breakfast
eat_breakfast.tip: Start the day with a calm, filling breakfast so you have energy.

hand_off_rings.title: Hand off rings
hand_off_rings.tip: Give the rings to the best man or another trusted person early.

remind_guests_camera.title: Remind guests about the camera
remind_guests_camera.tip: Add a welcome note or ask your MC to mention the guest camera.

download_guest_photos.title: Download guest photos
download_guest_photos.tip: Save all your guest-camera photos before the event link expires.

send_thank_you_notes.title: Send thank you notes
send_thank_you_notes.tip: Handwritten notes feel personal, even if they are short.

review_vendors.title: Review vendors
review_vendors.tip: Leave honest reviews to help future couples and thank your vendors.

update_name_documents.title: Update name documents
update_name_documents.tip: Start with your social security card if you are changing your name.

preserve_dress_bouquet.title: Preserve dress or bouquet
preserve_dress_bouquet.tip: Book preservation services quickly while the bouquet is still fresh.

reveal_film_with_guests.title: Reveal film with guests
reveal_film_with_guests.tip: Share a highlight film or invite guests to view the gallery.

share_guest_photos_album.title: Share guest photos album
share_guest_photos_album.tip: Send the guest photo album to everyone who contributed a photo.
